_about: Every reading of a held-out set, oldest first. The evaluation commands write their reading here before they measure anything, and refuse a second reading of the same file unless --again states why; the reason is kept beside the first reading.
A held-out set measures whether the improvements generalise. Read twice, its results start to steer the changes, which is the retrieval version of tuning a strategy on its own test period.
The first entry was written by hand: the RAG sprint read its held-out set once, on 2026-10-01, before this ledger existed.
